005927d4c145.name: Master of the Codex
005927d4c145.plain: When your Command phase starts, roll one D6 if this WARLORD is on the battlefield; you gain 1 command point on a 4+.

0b779ae36d63.name: Psychic Mastery
0b779ae36d63.plain: This WARLORD adds 1 to its Psychic tests.

0e08d8dfbc8c.name: Duellists
0e08d8dfbc8c.plain:
Melee attacks by models with this tactic automatically wound INFANTRY and BIKER units on an unmodified hit roll of 6.
You can't take this tactic if you've already chosen the Whirlwind of Rage tactic.

2057540248a4.name: Selfless Healer
2057540248a4.plain:
This WARLORD heals more with Combat Restoratives and can use the Combat Revival Stratagem for free.
• Each time it uses its Combat Restoratives ability, the model it heals gets back up to 3 lost wounds rather than D3.
• Each time you pick it to bring a destroyed model back to a unit with the Combat Revival Stratagem, that Stratagem costs 0 command points.

21c662c6e28c.name: Master Artisans
21c662c6e28c.plain: Each time a unit with this tactic is chosen to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one of the hit rolls for its attacks.

22a1d6d5e4bf.name: Inheritors of the Primarch
22a1d6d5e4bf.plain:
Pick one of the Chapters below and use its Chapter Tactic as your only Successor Tactic.
Choose from Blood Angels, Dark Angels, Imperial Fists, Iron Hands, Raven Guard, Salamanders, Space Wolves, Ultramarines or White Scars. You can't take this if you have already taken any other Successor Tactic, and once you take it you can't take a second.
If your Chapter is known in the published background as a successor of a particular First Founding Chapter, you must pick that Chapter's tactic.

waive.94: page reference ("as listed on page 94-95") for the Chapter Tactics, not part of the rule
waive.95: page reference ("as listed on page 94-95") for the Chapter Tactics, not part of the rule

25c126a979cb.name: Fear Made Manifest (Aura)
25c126a979cb.plain: Aura: while an enemy unit is within 6" of this WARLORD, subtract 1 from the Leadership of its models and from each Combat Attrition test taken for it.

262bca5f1790.name: Preferred Enemy
262bca5f1790.plain:
Models with this tactic re-roll melee hit rolls of 1 against units with one Faction keyword you pick from a list.
When you take this tactic, choose CHAOS KNIGHTS, TYRANIDS, AELDARI, ORK, HERETIC ASTARTES, NECRONS or T'AU EMPIRE.

29fc57c95ec2.name: Master of the Vanguard
29fc57c95ec2.plain:
Your <CHAPTER> PHOBOS units within 6" of this WARLORD add 1 to their charge rolls and move 1" further.
Each time such a unit is picked to make a Normal Move, Advance or Fall Back, it gets 1" extra Movement until the end of the turn.

319512e3287a.name: Master Marksman
319512e3287a.plain: This Warlord's ranged weapons, apart from Grenades and Relics, add 1 to their Damage characteristic.

34b9cc0fe650.name: No Hiding from the Watchers
34b9cc0fe650.plain:
In your opponent's Movement phase, pick one of your Dark Angels units within 9" of this WARLORD: this turn, it can make Heroic Interventions like a CHARACTER.
Until the end of the turn, it can do so from up to 6" away horizontally and 5" vertically from an enemy unit, and each of its models can move up to 6" when it does. All other Heroic Intervention rules still apply.

35e669ceeb10.name: Long-range Marksmen
35e669ceeb10.plain: Models with this tactic add 3" to the Range of their Rapid Fire and Heavy weapons, except Flame weapons.

waive.195: page reference ("see page 195") for Flame weapons, not part of the rule

364171c4d3cf.name: Warded
364171c4d3cf.plain: Whenever a mortal wound would make a model with this tactic lose a wound, roll one D6: on a 5+, the wound is not lost.

3a318de77e36.name: Champion of Humanity
3a318de77e36.plain:
This WARLORD adds 1 to its Attacks when in Engagement Range of enemy CHARACTER units, and to hit and wound rolls for its melee attacks against CHARACTER units.
The Attacks bonus applies each time it is within Engagement Range of any enemy CHARACTER units, and lasts until that fight is resolved.

3bf3857a7721.name: Lord of Deceit
3bf3857a7721.plain:
Once both armies are deployed, you can pick up to 3 of your <CHAPTER> PHOBOS units and redeploy them.
If the mission uses Strategic Reserves, you can put any of those units into Strategic Reserves at no additional CP cost, no matter how many units are already there. If both players have abilities that redeploy units, roll off: the winner picks who redeploys first.

3e611bab0520.name: Scions of the Forge
3e611bab0520.plain: If a model with this tactic has characteristics that change as it takes damage, use double its remaining wounds to work out those characteristics.

402d946dd005.name: Tactical Withdrawal
402d946dd005.plain: Units with this tactic can still declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.

4abd73b5ee6b.name: Storm of Fire
4abd73b5ee6b.plain: When a model in one of your <CHAPTER> CORE units within 6" of this WARLORD makes a ranged attack, an unmodified wound roll of 6 improves that attack's AP by 1.

595be0b30895.name: Relentless Seekers
595be0b30895.plain:
Unmodified wound rolls of 1 or 2 against units with this tactic always fail, and its PSYKER models can re-roll 1s on Psychic and Deny the Witch tests.
• The wound roll rule applies whatever abilities the weapon or the attacking model has.
• For Psychic tests and Deny the Witch tests taken for those PSYKER models, you can re-roll any or all dice that show a 1.

616c8bbdd2b9.name: Wise Orator
616c8bbdd2b9.plain:
This WARLORD adds 1 to the roll to see if its litanies are inspiring, and can use the Commanding Oratory Stratagem for 1 command point.
That price applies each time you choose this WARLORD to use the Stratagem.

7308c784d487.name: Fearsome Aspect
7308c784d487.plain: Units with this tactic gain the Fearsome Aspect aura: models in enemy units within 3" of them subtract 1 from their Leadership.

734c028549a6.name: Whirlwind of Rage
734c028549a6.plain:
If their unit charged, was charged or made a Heroic Intervention this turn, models with this tactic score 1 extra hit on each unmodified melee hit roll of 6.
You can't take this tactic if you've already chosen the Duellists tactic.

9f8a3d86464f.name: Stealth Adept
9f8a3d86464f.plain: Enemy models can't target this WARLORD with ranged attacks unless it is the closest eligible target.

9fca103adaa9.name: Stoic
9fca103adaa9.plain: Models with this tactic add 1 to their Leadership characteristic.

a2ca4935f6e3.name: Shoot and Fade
a2ca4935f6e3.plain: Once per turn, after a <CHAPTER> PHOBOS unit within 6" of this WARLORD shoots in your Shooting phase, it can make a Normal Move or Advance. If it does, it can't declare a charge this turn.

a5194568fedc.name: Steadfast Example
a5194568fedc.plain: While one of your <CHAPTER> CORE units is within 6" of this WARLORD, it has the Objective Secured ability. If a model in that unit already has that ability, it counts as one extra model when working out who controls an objective marker.

a6242f20f071.name: Hungry for Battle
a6242f20f071.plain: Units with this tactic add 1 to their Advance and charge rolls.

b2469f8f88d8.name: Knowledge is Power
b2469f8f88d8.plain: When a PSYKER unit with this tactic takes a Psychic test or Deny the Witch test, you can re-roll any or all of its dice that show a 1.

bfb86de90760.name: Warden of the Ancients
bfb86de90760.plain: While one of your <CHAPTER> DREADNOUGHTS is within 6" of this WARLORD, add 1 to that DREADNOUGHT's Strength and Attacks characteristics.

c14b385cb2ab.name: Born Heroes
c14b385cb2ab.plain: Models with this tactic add 1 to their melee hit rolls in a turn in which their unit made a charge move.

c1e588610ff5.name: The Imperium's Sword
c1e588610ff5.plain:
You can re-roll this WARLORD's charge rolls, and it adds 1 to its Strength and Attacks in fights after it charges or Heroically Intervenes.
The bonus applies each time it fights in a turn in which it made a charge move or performed a Heroic Intervention, and lasts until that Fight phase is resolved.

cd3d28459ecf.name: Rapid Assault
cd3d28459ecf.plain: Models with this tactic ignore the hit roll penalty for firing Assault weapons in a turn their unit Advanced.

d8ea87850499.name: Martial Exemplar
d8ea87850499.plain: Your <CHAPTER> CORE and <CHAPTER> CHARACTER units can re-roll charge rolls while they are within 6" of this WARLORD.

e3cb874e7b3e.name: Rites of War
e3cb874e7b3e.plain: Your <CHAPTER> CORE and <CHAPTER> CHARACTER units have the Objective Secured ability while they are within 6" of this WARLORD.

e9d9955ac1f6.name: Stealthy
e9d9955ac1f6.plain: Units with this tactic get the benefits of light cover against ranged attacks from attackers more than 18" away.

ef58c089afcc.name: Stalwart
ef58c089afcc.plain: Unmodified wound rolls of 1 or 2 always fail for attacks against units with this tactic, whatever abilities the weapon or attacker has.

f6b8791d209c.name: Target Priority
f6b8791d209c.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your <CHAPTER> PHOBOS units within 6" of this WARLORD to add 1 to the hit rolls of its ranged attacks. This lasts until the start of your next Command phase.

fbd7435e3823.name: Objective Secured
fbd7435e3823.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, every Troops unit in your ADEPTUS ASTARTES Detachments has this ability. You control an objective marker if any of your models with this ability are within range of it, even if your opponent has more models in range. If an enemy model in range also has this ability (or one like it), whoever has more models in range controls the marker, as normal. At the end of your Command phase, each objective marker you control that has one of these Troops units within range stays yours even if your models move off it. It only stops being yours when your opponent controls it at the end of a later phase.
